name: Branch SDK
plain: A SDK known for deferred deep links that also does attribution and clipboard-based matching.
meaning: Creates links that open the right in-app screen after install. Uses IDs, IP, device signals; on iOS it reads clipboard if the link was copied.

android.permission: INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE; AD_ID for GAID; Install Referrer library
android.store_policy: Data safety must list SDK data; Families: certified ad SDK rules
android.api_surface: MMP SDK + Play Install Referrer + GAID
android.note: Install Referrer plus Branch link params.

ios.permission: NSUserTrackingUsageDescription if IDFA used; privacy manifest from SDK
ios.store_policy: Privacy manifest and signature required for listed SDKs; ATT 5.1.2(i)
ios.note: Uses universal links, clipboard check (with iOS paste prompts since 16), SKAN.

data.metric: Install, session and event records tied to an MMP ID

fields.name: device ID
fields.range: GAID, IDFA or IDFV, MMP-specific ID

limits.headline: Can open the right screen after install and link the install to an ad
limits.user_action: You tap a Branch link, install the app, then open it
can: Open the right screen after install from a saved link
Match installs to ads using link data, IP address and device clues
Check what you copied on iPhone, with a paste notice since iOS 16
cannot: Check your clipboard on iPhone without the paste notice from iOS 16
Use the iPhone ad ID after you said no to tracking
See what you copied in apps outside its own link flow
limits.reach_label: A link and an install, then ongoing
limits.differs: Android uses the Play install referrer. iPhone checks the clipboard with a paste notice and uses Apple's reports.

story.what_it_is: An install tracking SDK best known for links that open the right screen even after installing.
story.for_you: You tap a friend's link, install the app and it opens on the exact page your friend meant. You may never realize a company stood in the middle.
story.for_makers: Branch creates deferred deep links, plus attribution. It matches by IDs, IP and device signals, and on iOS it can read the clipboard if a link was copied. That match is why a link can work across an install.

use_cases.example: You tap a shared product link, install the store app and land on the same product.
A friend invites you to a group and the app opens on that group after install.
A tournament invite link takes you to the right lobby after the game downloads.
An ad link carries a campaign tag so the advertiser knows which ad worked.
A challenge link from a friend opens the right workout challenge after install.
A growth team measures how many invites a user sends and how many join.

risks: Reads the clipboard in some cases
Uses IP and device signals to match
story.android_note: On Android it also uses the Play install referrer to connect the install to the click.
story.ios_note: iOS 14 added clipboard warnings that make this match more visible.

technical_bounds: Data flows to the vendor's cloud
Needs ATT for IDFA matching on iOS
Privacy manifest and required reasons apply

legit_uses: Attribution, fraud detection, deep links, ROAS

history.change: MMPs shift to SKAN and consent-gated IDFA for iOS
Privacy manifests and signatures required for the SDK
Privacy Sandbox wind-down: Install Referrer plus GAID remain the Android core
